example.en: Answer the questions by marking the corresponding letter on Answer Sheet 2.
example.zh: 在答题卡2上涂黑相应字母来回答问题。

more than.zh: 超过，多于；不仅仅，比…更（more than anything else）

example.en: It drew competitors from more than 40 countries.
example.zh: 它吸引了来自四十多个国家的参赛者。

example.en: He has to work late.
example.zh: 他得工作到很晚。

example.en: Giving kids pocket money according to their needs.
example.zh: 按孩子的需要给零花钱。

example.en: It is as famous as Cape Town.
example.zh: 它和开普敦一样有名。

example.en: He is going to visit a friend.
example.zh: 他打算去看望一位朋友。

example.en: Children must read at least 3 times a week.
example.zh: 孩子们每周必须至少阅读三次。

example.en: Words considered to be concrete could be easily visualized such as “table” or “chair”.
example.zh: 被认为具体的词很容易在脑中想象出来，比如“桌子”或“椅子”。

example.en: A lot of people don’t know about this movement.
example.zh: 很多人不了解这场运动。

example.en: Take smartphones for example.
example.zh: 以智能手机为例。

example.en: Cheating was getting more and more difficult for high school students.
example.zh: 作弊对高中生来说变得越来越难了。

example.en: Spend no more than 30 dollars.
example.zh: 花费不要超过三十美元。

example.en: He enjoys celebrating others’ birthdays rather than his own.
example.zh: 他喜欢庆祝别人的生日，而不是自己的。

example.en: Most end users do not understand the terms after reading them through.
example.zh: 大多数终端用户读完这些条款后也不理解。

example.en: Make a decision within a few days.
example.zh: 在几天内做出决定。

out of.zh: 离开，从……出来；出于；缺乏；（几个）中的

example.en: The elephant wandered out of the jungle and fell into the well.
example.zh: 大象从丛林里走出来，掉进了井里。

example.en: This was due to the risk of bird flu.
example.zh: 这是由于禽流感的风险。

example.en: It has risen because of bird flu.
example.zh: 由于禽流感，它上升了。

example.en: In fact, we need blue light during the day to be healthy.
example.zh: 事实上，我们白天需要蓝光才能保持健康。

example.en: They put jam instead of butter on bread.
example.zh: 他们在面包上抹果酱而不是黄油。

example.en: It’s not just about being entertained, but also being inspired.
example.zh: 这不只关乎得到娱乐，也关乎得到启发。

example.en: Research has found the use of digital technology benefits not only teenagers’ social lives but also their studies.
example.zh: 研究发现，使用数字技术不仅有益于青少年的社交生活，也有益于他们的学习。

example.en: I handle my own gold medal so gently that I would not scratch it.
example.zh: 我对待自己的金牌非常轻柔，以免刮伤它。

example.en: I’m getting a bit hungry.
example.zh: 我有点饿了。

example.en: Have a meal even if they have no money.
example.zh: 即使没有钱，也能吃上一顿饭。

used to.zh: 过去常常，曾经（现已不是）

example.en: He used to be a helicopter pilot.
example.zh: 他过去是一名直升机飞行员。

example.en: They are a little pricey, yes.
example.zh: 它们是有点贵，没错。

example.en: She no longer has any money left.
example.zh: 她不再有钱了。

example.en: There are a lot of reasons to want to keep your own last name.
example.zh: 想保留自己的姓有很多理由。

example.en: Compared with other racing series, Formula One focuses more on speed and involves more danger.
example.zh: 与其他赛车系列赛相比，一级方程式更注重速度，也更危险。

example.en: Of course, teens are still reading.
example.zh: 当然，青少年仍在阅读。

example.en: It may lead to bad as well as good habits.
example.zh: 它可能导致坏习惯，也可能导致好习惯。

example.en: She suffered from lung cancer.
example.zh: 她患有肺癌。

example.en: Pay either in cash or with his phone.
example.zh: 要么用现金支付，要么用他的手机支付。

example.en: Pay attention to the differences between genders.
example.zh: 要注意性别之间的差异。

example.en: Engage in a variety of psychological activities.
example.zh: 参与各种各样的心理活动。

example.en: Help people connect with each other.
example.zh: 帮助人们彼此联系。

example.en: She is too eager to please.
example.zh: 她太急于取悦别人了。

example.en: There are a number of different versions about the origin of the lion dance.
example.zh: 关于舞狮的起源有好几种不同的说法。

example.zh: 我在给我的侄子劳伦斯找一份礼物。

example.en: They tend to eat quite a lot.
example.zh: 他们往往吃得相当多。

example.en: Find out where Jimmy is.
example.zh: 查明吉米在哪里。

example.en: Beat challenges and take risks.
example.zh: 战胜挑战，勇于冒险。

example.en: They are similar in terms of social skills.
example.zh: 他们在社交能力方面很相似。

example.en: Compared with those findings, these numbers were shocking to me.
example.zh: 与那些发现相比，这些数字令我震惊。

example.zh: 硬奶酪怎么样？

example.en: Even though we basically know what will happen, we keep coming back for more.
example.zh: 尽管我们基本知道会发生什么，我们还是一再回来看。

example.en: Just make sure you’re logged in.
example.zh: 只要确保你已经登录。

example.en: It’s the same as conflicts.
example.zh: 这和冲突是一样的。

example.en: It has much to do with one’s genes.
example.zh: 这与一个人的基因有很大关系。

example.en: How much did she win?
example.zh: 她赢了多少？

example.en: This was the first record of six babies being born at the same time in that region.
example.zh: 这是该地区首次有六个婴儿同时出生的记录。

up to.zh: 多达，最多；由……决定，取决于；达到

example.en: That’s definitely up to you.
example.zh: 那绝对由你决定。

example.en: What should we take into account in order to make informed decisions?
example.zh: 为了做出明智的决定，我们应该考虑什么？

example.en: So as you can see, when it comes to choices, less is more.
example.zh: 如你所见，说到选择，少即是多。

account for.zh: 解释（原因）；占（比例）；考虑到

example.en: What accounted for the gender gap in airfares.
example.zh: 是什么造成了航班票价的性别差距。

example.en: He no longer has to worry about whether or not he can understand.
example.zh: 他不用再担心自己能不能听懂了。

at all.zh: 根本，完全（用于否定、疑问和条件句）

example.en: But that’s not what it means at all.
example.zh: 但那根本不是它的意思。

example.en: After all, it’s a good thing to know before actually accepting an offer.
example.zh: 毕竟，在真正接受录用前了解这些是件好事。

example.en: Would you like to join us?
example.zh: 你愿意加入我们吗？

example.en: It turns out that ASMR is pretty special.
example.zh: 结果发现ASMR相当特别。

example.en: More and more people are treating pet cats like their children.
example.zh: 越来越多的人把宠物猫当孩子对待。

example.en: The more calories, the better.
example.zh: 热量越多越好。

example.en: The event will take place at Methodist University.
example.zh: 活动将在卫理公会大学举行。

play a role.zh: 起作用，扮演角色，发挥作用

example.en: They play increasingly more important roles.
example.zh: 它们发挥着越来越重要的作用。

example.en: This is usually the case.
example.zh: 通常都是这样。

example.zh: 我还想要它小一点，这样在城里开起来方便。

example.zh: 平均每天九十克。

example.en: It should provide students with some basic knowledge.
example.zh: 它应该给学生提供一些基础知识。

example.en: She grew up in India.
example.zh: 她在印度长大。

example.en: They set up a branch in Dubai to manufacture coffee roasters.
example.zh: 他们在迪拜设立了一个分公司，生产咖啡烘焙机。

example.en: And speech obviously makes sense when you're driving.
example.zh: 开车时使用语音显然是合理的。

example.en: In other words, we’re all really, really stressed.
example.zh: 换句话说，我们都压力很大。

by oneself.zh: 独自，单独；靠自己，独立地

example.en: Doing the painting job all by themselves.
example.zh: 全靠他们自己完成这项粉刷工作。

in addition.zh: 此外；另外（in addition to 意为除…之外）

example.en: In addition to tuition, college students have to pay extra fees for the courses they take.
example.zh: 除了学费，大学生还要为所选课程额外付费。

example.en: Figure out which of the two is more reliable.
example.zh: 搞清楚这两个中哪个更可靠。

as long as.zh: 只要；既然…就；（时间）长达，只要…的时候

example.en: As long as there have been homework assignments and tests, there have been cheaters.
example.zh: 只要有作业和考试，就有作弊的人。

example.en: But this is far from ideal.
example.zh: 但这远非理想。

example.en: Early zoos are found all over the world.
example.zh: 早期的动物园遍布世界各地。

example.en: People tend to want as many choices as possible.
example.zh: 人们往往想要尽可能多的选择。

example.en: The concept has been applied to a wide range of disciplines.
example.zh: 这一概念已被应用于广泛的学科。

example.en: But now that you mention it, I do think getting another phone so soon is wasteful, regardless of the cost.
example.zh: 你这么一说，我确实觉得这么快再买部手机很浪费，不管多少钱。

example.en: The process seems so normal that we sometimes think of it as a
example.zh: 这个过程看起来太正常了，我们有时会把它看作……

example.zh: 学校参加 Design Ventura 比赛不需要付任何费用。

example.en: That is, American inequality means that the gains of

example.zh: 他还不够成熟，不能独立生活。

example.en: He ended up in the wrong place.
example.zh: 他最后到了错误的地方。

example.en: He points out that more than 200 genes influence weight.
example.zh: 他指出有超过200个基因影响体重。

example.en: It doesn’t take donations and doesn’t want to be seen as a charity.
example.zh: 它不接受捐款，也不想被看作慈善机构。

example.en: In addition to tuition, college students have to pay extra fees for the courses they take.
example.zh: 除了学费，大学生还要为所修课程支付额外费用。

example.en: Scotland will reach the national target in carbon emissions reduction ahead of schedule.
example.zh: 苏格兰将提前实现全国碳减排目标。

example.en: For instance, they may drop difficult coursework.
example.zh: 例如，他们可能会放弃难的课程。

work on.zh: 从事，致力于；研究，处理；修理

example.en: He was working on a study project with Jimmy.
example.zh: 他正和吉米一起做一个学习项目。

go on.zh: 发生，进行；继续；接着（做）（go on to do）

example.en: A long-standing debate is going on over the impact of school absences on students' academic performance.
example.zh: 关于缺课对学生学业表现的影响，一场长期的争论仍在进行。

example.en: Because when you are enjoying, people around you will begin to enjoy as well.
example.zh: 因为当你乐在其中时，你周围的人也会开始乐在其中。

no matter.zh: 无论，不管（后接 what / how / who 等）

example.en: Technology, no matter how advanced, should simply be a tool of a good teacher.
example.zh: 无论技术多么先进，它都应仅仅是好老师的工具。

example.en: Self-control only brings about small benefits.
example.zh: 自控只能带来小小的好处。

go through.zh: 经历，经受；仔细检查，逐一过一遍；办理（手续）

example.en: What Kelli Harding went through in Washington changed her life.
example.zh: 凯莉·哈丁在华盛顿的经历改变了她的人生。

example.en: It’s a shame you missed out on the general discount.
example.zh: 你错过了通用折扣，真可惜。

example.en: Remind people to cut down on snacking.
example.zh: 提醒人们少吃零食。

example.en: She was coughing all the time.
example.zh: 她一直在咳嗽。

example.en: It is important to understand what causes your stress in the first place.
example.zh: 弄清楚是什么首先造成了你的压力很重要。

in a way.zh: 在某种程度上，从某种意义上说

example.en: "In a way," she said, the rooster "stands for 'We The People.'"
example.zh: 她说，在某种程度上，这只公鸡“代表着‘我们人民’”。

example.en: Take care of their well-being.
example.zh: 关心他们的健康与幸福。

example.en: They will find they have something in common.
example.zh: 他们会发现彼此有共同点。

take on.zh: 承担，接下（任务、责任）；呈现（特征）；采用

example.en: It's best to take on the most difficult task second—once they're settled, but before they get tired.
example.zh: 最好把最难的任务排在第二个——等他们安顿下来之后、疲劳之前。

example.en: And whatever their financial background, or their educational background, most people will have something in common with each other.
example.zh: 无论经济背景还是教育背景如何，大多数人彼此都会有些共同之处。

take time off.zh: 休假，请假；抽出时间休息

example.en: Leaders should take time off themselves and encourage employees to do the same.
example.zh: 领导者自己应该休假，并鼓励员工也这样做。

most likely.zh: 很可能，十有八九；最有可能（be most likely to）

example.en: Some analysts find age 45+ jobless workers are most likely to be unemployed for more than a year.
example.zh: 一些分析人士发现，45岁以上的失业工人最有可能失业超过一年。

example.en: Volunteers visit the Games’ website to sign up.
example.zh: 志愿者访问运动会的网站报名。

example.en: Poor people may have to give up eating certain foods because of their high prices.
example.zh: 穷人可能因为某些食物价格高而不得不放弃吃它们。

example.en: We’re eating more fish than ever these days.
example.zh: 如今我们吃的鱼比以往任何时候都多。

example.en: Look after her grandfather.
example.zh: 照顾她的祖父。

example.en: He is a sign language interpreter.
example.zh: 他是一名手语翻译。

example.en: It generates a great deal of electronic garbage.
example.zh: 它产生大量电子垃圾。

example.zh: 这些事情产生了巨大的影响。

example.en: Take advantage of the latest technologies.
example.zh: 利用最新的技术。

example.zh: 但自行车道已成定局，很快就建好了。

example.en: It brought in the most advanced instruments.
example.zh: 它引进了最先进的仪器。

example.en: In contrast, they felt less judged by members of their own group.
example.zh: 相比之下，他们感觉自己群体的成员对他们的评判较少。

come in.zh: 名列（第几）；（价格等）为；出现；到来

example.zh: 在接下来两年里，赤朗姆没能夺冠，两次都屈居第二。

example.en: In particular, dangerous conditions such as icy roads or wet ground could cause difficulty for drivers.
example.zh: 尤其是结冰的道路或潮湿的地面等危险状况，可能给司机带来困难。

example.en: In reality, education does an aging brain good.
example.zh: 实际上，教育对衰老的大脑有益。

make up.zh: 构成，占（比例）；弥补（时间）；编造

example.en: Those over 45 make up the bulk of the long-term
example.zh: 45岁以上的人占长期失业者的大部分

example.en: "They came up with this," he says.
example.zh: 他说：“是他们想出来的。”

example.en: An operating system capable of doing several tasks at once.
example.zh: 一个能同时执行多项任务的操作系统。

example.en: At first, you just eliminate the obvious distractions and explore the rest.
example.zh: 起初，你只需排除明显的干扰，再去探索其余的。

example.en: It could be reshaped into animals other than rabbits.
example.zh: 它可以被重塑成兔子以外的动物。

example.en: Wood has such health benefits that the Woodland Trust successfully lobbied for it to be prescribed by doctors.
example.zh: 木材有如此多的健康益处，以至于林地信托成功游说让医生把它开进处方。

find oneself.zh: 发现自己处于（某种状态、境地）

example.en: A few years ago I found myself teaching a university class on evil.
example.zh: 几年前，我发现自己在大学里教一门关于邪恶的课。

example.en: Both groups attach importance to social connections.
example.zh: 两组人都重视社会联系。

example.en: It assumes that human beings are all good-natured.
example.zh: 它假定人类都是善良的。

example.en: You have to pay back your commitment at some point.
example.zh: 你总有一天要兑现你的承诺。

example.en: The technology is also known as autonomous cruise control.
example.zh: 这项技术也被称为自动巡航控制。

example.zh: 例如，女性在心脏病发作前更可能出现睡眠紊乱、焦虑和异常疲劳。

example.en: Artificial intelligence just isn't smart enough yet.
example.zh: 人工智能还不够聪明。

example.zh: 它使矿场的运营陷入停顿。

example.zh: 它位于一家帽子工厂旁边。

example.zh: 这绝对由你来决定。

example.zh: 与家长的想法相反，孩子们努力在网上少留痕迹。

example.zh: 这反过来又帮助我们成为更好的谈判者和抽象思考者。

example.zh: 这可能让人觉得自己应该融入外面的世界。

believe in.zh: 相信…的存在；信任，信奉；赞成

example.zh: Chetan-Walsh 赞成禁止一次性瓶子。

example.en: It was tourists not natives who were cleaning up the beach.
example.zh: 是游客，而不是当地人，在清理海滩。

take up.zh: 开始从事（爱好、活动）；占用（空间、时间）；接手，处理（问题）；担任（职位）

example.en: More and more people are taking up extreme sports, like snowboarding, skateboarding, mountain biking, and many more.
example.zh: 越来越多的人开始从事极限运动，比如单板滑雪、滑板、山地自行车等。

example.en: It's a shame you missed out on the general discount.
example.zh: 你错过了普通折扣，真可惜。

charge sb with sth.zh: 指控，控告某人（罪名）；使充满（情感），赋予；让某人负责（be charged with）

example.en: She was charged with mistreating animals.
example.zh: 她被控虐待动物。

example.en: Watch the series together with the woman.
example.zh: 和那位女士一起看这部剧。

why not.zh: 为什么不（提出建议）；为什么不呢

example.en: Why not just pay with your phone?
example.zh: 为什么不直接用手机付款呢？

example.zh: 来点健康的东西怎么样？

example.en: One is simply enjoying their time off work.
example.zh: 一种是单纯享受他们的下班休息时间。

example.en: When she did sleep, she experienced “problem-solving dreams,” which left her feeling unrested when she woke up.
example.zh: 她真睡着时，会做“解决问题的梦”，这让她醒来时感觉没休息好。

turn up.zh: 出现，到场；被找到，冒出来

example.en: Bundles of £20 notes kept turning up.
example.zh: 一捆捆20英镑的钞票不断冒出来。

example.zh: 他们互相帮忙掩盖自己的行为。

example.en: No problem.
example.zh: 没问题。

a body of.zh: 大量的，一批（研究、证据、作品等）

example.zh: 这些发现很重要，因为越来越多的证据表明狗能在许多方面帮助孩子。

example.zh: 照常吃饭以免挨饿。

example.zh: 它们能减少某些药物不必要的副作用。

move forward.zh: 向前发展，取得进展；继续前进

example.en: Expect future success so as to move forward.
example.zh: 期待未来的成功，以便不断前进。

example.zh: 据估计，它占英国食物浪费总量的不到百分之一。

example.zh: 另一方面，休闲着装能让我们更友好、更有创造力。

example.zh: 黄金法则有时必须让位于更重要的原则。

example.zh: 在行动之前吸收新信息有助于做出更好的决定。

example.zh: 人们对一级方程式赛车能否在美国推广看法不一。

look to.zh: 指望，依靠；打算，期望；展望

example.en: Across the U.S., families are looking to the winter with fear as energy costs soar.
example.zh: 在美国各地，随着能源成本飙升，家庭们担忧地展望着冬天。

example.en: Fraudsters advertise their villas at reasonable prices so as not to be suspected.
example.zh: 骗子以合理的价格宣传他们的别墅，以免被怀疑。

example.zh: 工作满意度与公司文化关系很大。

example.zh: 在这个问题上有几种妥协的办法。

example.zh: 总体而言，对普通美国工人来说完全不是这样。

example.en: They make use of modern technology.
example.zh: 他们利用现代科技。

example.en: What does the author suggest people do to get rid of boredom?
example.zh: 作者建议人们怎样摆脱无聊？

example.en: The art of persuasion means convincing others to agree with your point of view or to follow your course of action.
example.zh: 说服的艺术是让别人同意你的观点或按你的做法行事。

in the absence of.zh: 在没有……的情况下，缺少……时

example.en: In the absence of Federal legislation, some states in the US have passed laws concerning paid family leave.
example.zh: 在缺乏联邦立法的情况下，美国一些州已通过了有关带薪家庭假的法律。

example.en: She didn’t sign up for membership in time.
example.zh: 她没有及时注册会员。

example.en: “Fathers may fare better than mothers in part due to how they spend time with their children,” said lead author Katherine Nelson-Coffey.
example.zh: “父亲们比母亲们表现更好，部分是因为他们陪孩子的方式。”主要作者凯瑟琳·尼尔森-科菲说。

example.en: But now that she ran out of money, she can’t.
example.zh: 但既然她的钱花光了，她就不能了。

example.zh: 这需要得当的帮助。

example.en: The platform will allow refugees worldwide to take thousands of online courses for free.
example.zh: 这个平台将让全世界的难民免费学习数千门在线课程。

call on.zh: 点名（让某人发言）；号召，呼吁；拜访

example.en: They may feel helpless when called on by the instructor.
example.zh: 被老师点名时，他们可能会感到无助。

on the way.zh: 在途中，在…路上；即将到来；正走向（on the way to）

example.en: There’s that American style diner on the way to the mall.
example.zh: 去商场的路上有那家美式餐馆。

example.en: Emotional intelligence helps people get along with others.
example.zh: 情商帮助人们与他人相处。

example.en: This theory guesses that after developing sign languages, people eventually started making sounds along with their gestures.
example.zh: 这一理论推测，在发展出手语之后，人们最终开始在做手势的同时发出声音。

not really.zh: 不太，并不真的；其实不是（委婉否定）

example.en: Not really.
example.zh: 不见得。/并不是。

example.en: Over the years, other creatures like frogs and fish have found their way into toilets.
example.zh: 多年来，青蛙和鱼之类的其他生物也曾设法进入马桶。

example.en: What's more, the 7,000 or so languages that exist today vary dramatically in how they utilize numbers.
example.zh: 而且，如今存在的约七千种语言在使用数字的方式上差异极大。

example.en: Correct their mistake as soon as possible.
example.zh: 尽快纠正他们的错误。

example.en: With those born with natural talents, it feels as if they excel without really trying.
example.zh: 对于天生有才能的人，感觉他们不用真正努力就能出类拔萃。

apart from.zh: 除…之外（另有）；除…以外（不包括）

example.en: Joyce suggests that apart from self-care, women should seek professional support if they experience severe stress.
example.zh: 乔伊斯建议，除了自我照顾外，女性在承受严重压力时还应寻求专业帮助。

example.en: Setting up a spoken web is by no means an easy task.
example.zh: 建立口语网络绝非易事。

i mean.zh: 我是说，我的意思是（口语补充说明）

example.en: I mean, getting rid of rush hour may be impossible, but it could be made more tolerable, don’t you think?
example.zh: 我是说，要消除高峰时段也许不可能，但可以让它更容易忍受，你觉得呢？

example.en: What if an accident happens or you get ill and need medical treatment?
example.zh: 万一发生意外或你生病需要治疗怎么办？

at risk.zh: 处于危险中，有风险（at risk of 面临…风险）

example.en: New research suggests that pandas may be at risk of dying out because they are too comfortable.
example.zh: 新研究表明，大熊猫可能因为太安逸而面临灭绝的风险。

example.en: Smart people also have a hard time accepting feedback.
example.zh: 聪明人也很难接受反馈。

example.en: So far, eight states and the District of Columbia have their own paid family leave laws.
example.zh: 到目前为止，已有八个州和哥伦比亚特区制定了自己的带薪家庭假法律。

example.en: It has gone up sharply.

example.zh: 加快对刑事案件的调查。

example.en: Here, at this point in the argument, it’s traditional for me to bring up all the studies that show the benefits of napping.
example.zh: 论证到这里，按惯例我该提出所有说明午睡好处的研究了。

catch up.zh: 赶上，追上；补上（落下的）；（catch up on）补做

example.en: They need extra help to catch up in the math class.
example.zh: 他们需要额外帮助才能赶上数学课的进度。

work out.zh: 弄清，想出；算出；结果是；（事情）成功

example.en: But working out how to behave online is a new social skill.
example.zh: 但弄明白在网上该如何举止，是一项新的社交技能。

example.en: It has to be carried out to the letter.
example.zh: 必须一丝不苟地执行。

example.en: Fill out a more comprehensive checklist, and be wary of listed prices that seem too low.
example.zh: 填写一份更全面的清单，并警惕看起来过低的标价。

example.en: He has escaped the zoo once again.
example.zh: 它又一次从动物园逃走了。

example.en: Some think voice could soon take over from typing and clicking as the main way to interact online.
example.zh: 有人认为语音很快会取代打字和点击，成为网上互动的主要方式。

example.en: Thinking twice before buying something.
example.zh: 买东西前要三思。

get ahead.zh: 取得进步，出人头地，领先

example.zh: 这阻碍了他们出人头地。

example.en: Should parents and teachers take away teens’ smartphones and replace them with paper books?
example.zh: 家长和老师应该拿走青少年的智能手机，换成纸质书吗？

take note.zh: 注意，留意（常用 take note of）

example.en: Take note of the message though fatigued.
example.zh: 尽管疲倦，也要留意这条信息。

example.en: How often he does shopping.
example.zh: 他多久购物一次。

example.en: Make friends with Jimmy.

shut down.zh: 关闭，停止运转；（情感上）封闭自己

example.en: They simply shut themselves down.
example.zh: 他们干脆把自己关闭了。

example.zh: 最聪明的人和最强的领导者有时会犯别人不会犯的错误，尤其是在需要常识的情况下。

example.en: Learning can benefit you by itself but only practice can turn what you learn into meaningful contributions.
example.zh: 学习本身对你有益，但只有实践才能把所学变成有意义的贡献。

example.en: Well, for example, the subway system could have air conditioning.
example.zh: 比如说，地铁系统可以装上空调。

example.en: I’ve never been to the head office, you know.
example.zh: 你知道的，我从没去过总部。

example.en: Nursing homes should be strictly limited in size.
example.zh: 养老院的规模应当受到严格限制。

example.en: It shows a daring foresight regarding future fine dining.
example.zh: 它显示出对未来高档餐饮的大胆远见。

example.zh: 这表明小赢家以后会变成更大的赢家。

example.zh: 你会穿过尽可能多的商店区域，并在途中被诱惑。

example.zh: 运动会时隔五年再次回归。

example.zh: “孩子们仍然会面对面相处，”伦哈特说。

example.zh: 他期待着收到亲密朋友送的礼物。

example.zh: 首先，求职者应该明确他们对未来雇主有什么期待。

example.zh: 这项研究发现，大学生在有不同种族的观察者在场时，比有同种族观察者在场时更可能选择健康食物。

example.zh: 向她的父母求助。

example.zh: 他爱它们，但不想小题大做。

example.zh: 在一项实验中，研究人员会每次往罐子里放一颗坚果。

example.zh: 他把养老院搞得一团糟。

example.zh: 我们认为有些衣服显得有力量，有些显得有趣，等等。

example.zh: 它们在不久的将来可能变成稀罕的享受。

in conjunction with.zh: 与…一起，与…协同；（in conjunction）结合起来

example.zh: 它们与环境协同作用。

example.en: It seemed to make up for his physical defects.
example.zh: 这似乎弥补了他身体上的缺陷。

example.zh: 比赛的艰苦让参赛者几乎想吃什么就吃什么。

example.zh: 透明塑料瓶的制造商也可能为了省钱而选择新的化石燃料塑料。

example.zh: 现在到了你戴上侦探帽、稍微深入挖掘一下的环节。

example.zh: 这可能会在以后给年轻人带来问题。

example.zh: 从账面上看，我的开销和助学金基本持平。

example.zh: 他们的智慧随着时间流逝而增长。

example.zh: 而且，如今存在的七千种左右的语言在使用数字的方式上差异极大。

example.zh: 随着夜幕降临，常常能看到成群骑行者几乎朝每个方向穿行在街道和人行道上。

example.zh: 即便如此，最近仍有极少数案例，当局在进一步检查中发现了虫卵。

all right.zh: 好吧，行（表同意）；还不错，没问题

example.en: It looks all right.
example.zh: 看起来还不错。

example.zh: 里面到处都是各种电子游戏角色。

example.zh: 这项活动已进行两周，莫里斯说有近50位顾客领取了免费餐。

example.zh: 这启发安德莉亚打扮得漂漂亮亮去倒垃圾。

example.zh: 它能使人增强耐力。

put up.zh: 张贴，挂起；提供（资金）；搭建

example.zh: 它们来这家店太频繁，以至于店员不得不贴出告示，请顾客不要喂它们。

back up.zh: 支持，证实；备份；（车辆）堵塞排队

example.en: And Game Academy reckons its belief is backed up by hard data.
example.zh: 游戏学院认为自己的看法有确凿数据支持。

example.zh: 人们着手改善健康时，通常会走一条熟悉的路。

example.zh: 如果说凯莉很出众，那是因为她还是个有天赋的作家。

example.zh: 要考虑别人的喜好。

example.zh: 艾伦出生后不久就被送给别人收养，沃尔特则从未见过自己的父亲。

example.zh: 要做到高效需要适应能力，这是你在学校里都学不到的，更不用说六个月的培训营了。

example.en: The toughness of the race allows for racers to eat pretty much whatever they want.
example.zh: 比赛的艰苦让选手几乎可以想吃什么就吃什么。

help oneself.zh: 随便吃（拿）；自己动手；自助

example.en: I imagine there will be different foods and people will just help themselves and eat at their own pace, right?
example.zh: 我想会有各种食物，大家自己取用，按自己的节奏吃，对吧？

example.en: Staff did their best to discourage the pet from hanging around.

example.zh: 在户外玩耍，玩得开心。

example.en: To show off her riches and power.
example.zh: 为了炫耀她的财富和权力。

take off.zh: 起飞；流行起来，迅速发展

example.en: No injuries were reported on the plane, and the flight took off once again 7.5 hours after the first attempt.
example.zh: 飞机上无人受伤，航班在首次尝试7.5小时后又一次起飞。

pay off.zh: 取得成功，有回报；还清（债务）

example.en: These closer bonds and greater attachment pay off.
example.zh: 这些更紧密的联系和更深的依恋会带来回报。

example.zh: 他们中几乎所有的几十年前就倒闭了。

example.zh: 然而，美国的储蓄率近几十年来一直在下降，而不是上升。

come across.zh: 偶然遇到，偶然发现；（come across as）给人……的印象

example.zh: 当地警察偶然发现了成捆的20英镑纸币。

example.zh: 我摔倒时落地姿势不好，稍微扭了一下，但没什么大不了。

ever since.zh: 自从那时以来，从那以后；自从……以来

example.en: The same discount of 20% is being offered to everyone at the door on a “first come, first served” basis for the first month.
example.zh: 第一个月，在门口按“先到先得”的原则向所有人提供同样的八折优惠。

example.en: is not how the two pieces of work and life come together.
example.zh: ……并不是工作和生活这两部分结合在一起的方式。

go ahead.zh: （计划等）继续进行，获准进行；（对人）请便

example.en: Surprisingly, the Space Roaster concept—should it go ahead—will not be the first attempt to take coffee into space.
example.zh: 令人惊讶的是，“太空烘焙机”这一构想（如果能推进的话）并不是首次尝试把咖啡带入太空。

example.en: And then, if you still wanted to give money as some sort of apology or something, he probably shouldn’t have to go around borrowing it from people.
example.zh: 然后，如果你还想给一笔钱作为某种道歉，他大概也不该四处向别人借钱。

example.en: They prefer to go after all that is novel.
example.zh: 他们更喜欢追求一切新奇的东西。

be anything to go by.zh: 如果以……为依据（判断）；若可作参考

example.en: district is anything to go by.
example.zh: ……如果以该学区为依据来判断的话。

example.en: Kelli wastes no time taking potshots at the medical establishment and its body-centered biomedicine methods.
example.zh: 凯莉毫不迟疑地随意抨击医疗机构及其以身体为中心的生物医学方法。

follow sb's lead.zh: 效仿某人，以某人为榜样

example.en: He hopes private institutions in Ohio follow the lead of the state and post similar information.
example.zh: 他希望俄亥俄州的私立机构效仿该州，公布类似的信息。

drive sth home.zh: 使深入人心，使（人）深刻认识到

example.en: That reality was driven home this month by a new Los Angeles Homeless Services Authority report showing that the county's homeless population is growing faster than the supply of new housing.
example.zh: 洛杉矶无家可归者服务局本月的一份新报告让人深刻认识到了这一现实：该县无家可归人口的增长快于新住房的供应。

example.en: It will gradually pass away without teachers' help.
example.zh: 没有老师的帮助，它会逐渐消失。

example.en: The vast island usually locks away enough fresh water in its ice sheet, which if melted can raise global sea levels by six meters.
example.zh: 这座广阔的岛屿通常把足够多的淡水封存在冰盖里，这些水一旦融化，可使全球海平面上升六米。

example.en: Kids tend to take note if their parents put their phone away at dinner or charge it in another room while they sleep.
example.zh: 如果父母在晚饭时把手机收起来，或在睡觉时把手机放到另一个房间充电，孩子往往会留意到。

example.en: Everything from specialist cheeses to sought-after coffee beans gets thrown away every day in the current food system.
example.zh: 在当前的食品体系里，从特色奶酪到抢手的咖啡豆，各种东西每天都被扔掉。

example.en: The best entertainment and storytelling comes from people who are relatable—those who don’t shy away from opening up but freely share who they are and what they care about.
example.zh: 最好的娱乐和叙事来自让人有共鸣的人——那些不回避敞开心扉、而是坦然分享自己是谁、在乎什么的人。

example.en: Bacteria accumulate because there isn’t enough water in your mouth to wash it away.
example.zh: 细菌之所以积聚，是因为你口中没有足够的水把它冲走。

explain away.zh: （通过解释）消除，排除；辩解开脱

example.en: None of these explained away the gender gap, so we applied data collected from surveys that express consumer preferences.
example.zh: 这些因素都没能解释掉性别差距，所以我们采用了通过调查收集的、体现消费者偏好的数据。

example.en: A lot of research comes to the same conclusion that fruit juice does harm to the human body when it leads to surplus
example.zh: 许多研究得出了相同的结论：果汁导致热量过剩时会对人体有害。

hear from.zh: 收到（某人的）来信或消息，得到……的音讯

example.en: We haven’t heard from him since.
example.zh: 那以后我们就再没有他的消息了。

example.en: The dog owner’s family are currently in the process of moving.
example.zh: 狗主人一家目前正在搬家。

example.en: Sure thing.
example.zh: 当然没问题。

example.en: he damaged someone’s car and wanted to get some money together to make up for the damage he’d caused.
example.zh: 他损坏了别人的车，想凑一些钱来弥补自己造成的损失。

example.en: But when people make decisions for others, they typically put together a more diverse team.
example.zh: 但当人们为别人做决定时，他们通常会组建一个更多元化的团队。

example.en: To feel how difficult it is to get his idea across.
example.zh: 去感受把他的想法表达清楚有多难。

example.en: If you find yourself searching for something to say beyond small talk, try these tactics to find more interesting approaches to conversation.
example.zh: 如果你发现自己想在闲聊之外找点话说，试试这些策略，找到更有趣的交谈方式。

example.en: In our house, we have transparent money boxes for them to put small change in, so they can see their savings grow.
example.zh: 在我们家，有透明的储蓄罐让他们存放零钱，这样他们就能看到自己的积蓄在增长。

put the spotlight on.zh: 使成为焦点，使受到关注

example.en: sugar's role in heart disease-and put the spotlight squarely on dietary fat.
example.zh: ……糖在心脏病中的作用，并把焦点完全放到了膳食脂肪上。

example.en: It was put forward by King Kullen.
example.zh: 它是由金·库伦提出的。

example.en: The researchers put forth policy contributions, ranging from sustainable disposal of leftover stock to production tax to incentivize both manufacturers and consumers to be more waste conscious.
example.zh: 研究人员提出了政策建议，从可持续处理剩余库存到征收生产税，以激励制造商和消费者提高减少浪费的意识。

example.en: People think focus means saying ‘yes’ to the thing you’ve got to focus on.
example.zh: 人们认为专注意味着对你必须专注的那件事说“是”。

example.en: What's more, homes built in the 2000s were more likely than earlier models to have more of all types of spaces; bedrooms, bathrooms, living rooms, dining rooms, recreation rooms and garages.
example.zh: 此外，2000年代建造的住宅比早期住宅更可能拥有更多各种类型的空间：卧室、浴室、客厅、餐厅、娱乐室和车库。

example.en: I still kept wishing that I didn’t have to play catch-up with the money world.
example.zh: 我仍一直希望自己不必在金钱世界里奋起直追。

example.en: They are able to bring their potential into fuller play.
example.zh: 他们能够让自己的潜力得到更充分的发挥。

example.en: It’s written by a Chinese science fiction writer.
example.zh: 它是由一位中国科幻作家写的。

take notice.zh: 注意到，留意（常作 take notice of）

example.en: When an experimenter from the research team took notice.
example.zh: 当研究团队的一名实验人员注意到时。

example.en: transformation project gone wrong, where swollen expectations have been popped and a long list of
example.zh: ……一个出了问题的转型项目，其中膨胀的期望已被戳破……

example.en: If we can show the possibilities of eating plant-based food in this setting, it can open a lot of doors for others to follow.
example.zh: 如果我们能在这种环境中展示吃植物性食物的可能性，就能为其他人打开许多扇门，让他们效仿。

example.en: Blood sugar cause the release of insulin to bring it back down to a stable level.
example.zh: 血糖会促使胰岛素释放，把它重新降到稳定的水平。

example.en: So have you got your mind set on a specific model?
example.zh: 那你已经看中某个具体型号了吗？

second nature.zh: 第二天性，习惯成自然的事

example.en: You probably have to help younger children plan their session, but it’s important that by the end of primary school it’s second nature.
example.zh: 你可能得帮年幼的孩子规划学习时段，但重要的是到小学结束时，这应成为他们的第二天性。

example.en: Yes, it really can be difficult getting a new job after age 45, let alone changing careers.
example.zh: 是的，45岁以后找新工作确实很难，更不用说转行了。

example.en: They usually turn a blind eye to their own weaknesses.
example.zh: 他们通常对自己的弱点视而不见。

feel free to.zh: 随意，不必客气地（做某事）

example.en: Please feel free to call me for any further questions.
example.zh: 如有任何其他问题，请随时给我打电话。

example.en: I had no idea Japan made jeans.
example.zh: 我根本不知道日本生产牛仔裤。

example.en: For that age group, our biggest seller this year has been this action figure.
example.zh: 对这个年龄段来说，我们今年卖得最好的就是这款人偶玩具。

example.en: Generally speaking, soft cheeses are creamy and go well with sweet things like honey and jam.
example.zh: 一般来说，软奶酪质地绵滑，很适合搭配蜂蜜、果酱之类的甜食。

example.en: To make sure this wasn't by chance, Wang conducted additional tests.
example.zh: 为确保这不是偶然，王进行了额外的测试。

example.en: Researchers have previously found a link between eating more fruits and vegetables, and improved longer term mental health.
example.zh: 研究人员此前发现，多吃水果蔬菜与长期心理健康的改善之间存在关联。

example.en: Skills shortages in many jobs such as animation and special effects.
example.zh: 动画和特效等许多工作都存在技能人才短缺。

example.en: So have you got your mind set on a specific model?
example.zh: 那么你心里有看中的具体型号了吗？

example.en: Living beyond her means.
example.zh: 过着超出自己经济能力的生活。

example.en: It has led some other companies to follow suit.
example.zh: 这促使其他一些公司也效仿。

example.en: They are nowhere near as popular as they used to be when we were children.
example.zh: 它们远不如我们小时候那么受欢迎了。

example.en: Whether that’s likely, or even possible, anytime soon, is anyone’s guess.
example.zh: 这在短期内是否有可能、甚至是否可行，谁也说不准。

example.en: Scotland will reach the national target in carbon emissions reduction ahead of schedule.
example.zh: 苏格兰将提前实现国家碳减排目标。

example.en: That means no running red lights or traveling in the opposite direction of traffic on one-way streets.
example.zh: 这意味着不能闯红灯，也不能在单行道上逆行。

example.en: It was caused by a lorry running into a trailer.
example.zh: 事故是一辆货车撞上一辆拖车造成的。

example.en: He said the people who should be paying regard to the Wang paper are the funding agents.
example.zh: 他说，应该重视王这篇论文的是出资机构。

example.en: that teenagers will be able to take a natural history test
example.zh: 青少年将能参加博物学测验。

example.en: There are some factors that could affect the budget moving forward.
example.zh: 有一些因素今后可能会影响预算。

example.en: At around half past nine this morning, a trailer attached to a lorry turned over at the crossing of High Street in Milton.
example.zh: 今天上午九点半左右，一辆货车挂着的拖车在米尔顿高街的路口翻倒了。

example.en: Fats and sugar have taken the beating in turns since over a century ago.
example.zh: 一个多世纪以来，脂肪和糖轮番遭到抨击。

example.en: A good suit works wonders for our performance in the boardroom.
example.zh: 一套好西装对我们在会议室的表现有奇效。

get sb nowhere.zh: 对某人毫无帮助，徒劳无功

example.en: It gets us nowhere.
example.zh: 这对我们毫无帮助。

example.en: I’ve never done it before and I know that you’ve been doing it for ages.
example.zh: 我以前从没做过，而我知道你已经做了很久了。

example.en: It is a unique trait specific to the human race.
example.zh: 这是人类特有的独特特征。

example.en: The KaiOS devices offer an alternative to the more expensive models that remain out of reach of many Africans and contribute to the digital divide.
example.zh: KaiOS 设备为许多非洲人买不起的较贵机型提供了替代选择，而这些机型加剧了数字鸿沟。

example.en: Besides, I don’t think I could ever give up a good hot dog at a baseball game.
example.zh: 再说，我觉得我永远没法在棒球赛上放弃一份好吃的热狗。

behind closed doors.zh: 私下里；在不公开的场合

example.en: These questions can reveal what it’s really like behind closed doors.
example.zh: 这些问题能揭示内部实际是什么样子。

example.en: In certain countries, men can publicly hold hands as signs of brotherhood or friendship.
example.zh: 在某些国家，男性可以公开牵手，以表示兄弟情或友谊。

example.en: He was shaking hands with other members as they walked through the door.
example.zh: 他在其他成员走进门时和他们一一握手。

example.en: Not all books are created equal, so parents need to choose the books they share with their children with great care.
example.zh: 并非所有书都一样好，所以父母要非常用心地挑选与孩子共读的书。

example.en: A new systematic review brings us usefully up-to-date on the current findings in this area.
example.zh: 一项新的系统性综述让我们切实了解了该领域的最新发现。

example.en: Their conclusions about what The Guardian described as this “sweet spot” are in line with the so-called Goldilocks
example.zh: 他们关于这个“最佳点”的结论与所谓的“金发姑娘原则”相符。

example.en: Kate placed the order and ran off to play.
example.zh: 凯特下了单，跑去玩了。

example.en: At the gate of a grade school in Kent.
example.zh: 在肯特郡一所小学的门口。

example.en: David Foulkes studies children to bring the secrets of their dreams to the light of day.
example.zh: 大卫·福克斯研究儿童，以揭开他们梦境的秘密。
